statements.__comment: Only nodes no sync has written for 24h (86400s; lastupdated is a sync start time, reused across a paginated run) are swept, so a node another worker has just written and not yet linked survives.
statements.query: MATCH (n:GitHubUser) WHERE NOT (n)--() AND coalesce(n.lastupdated, 0) < $UPDATE_TAG - 86400 WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

name: orphan sweep of shared GitHubUser nodes
